yppwddir.description: Location of the master NIS password file (for yppasswdd).

ypchangeok.description: Which user tools (ychsh, ychfn) are allowed. Possible values: "chsh", "chfn", "chsh,chfn".

nismaster.description: NIS master server hostname. Empty if this host is not a slave server or no master is configured.

ypserv_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the ypserv daemon (e.g., "-p 1053").

ypbnd_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the ypbind daemon (e.g., "-s domain").

yppasswdd_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the yppasswdd daemon (e.g., "-s domain").

ypxfrd_opts.description: Command-line options passed to the ypxfrd daemon (e.g., "-c").
